title: Harvest festival
lead: A goal, the amounts received and what the site shows of them. The treasurer enters each amount; someone else validates it. Only the validated total is public: never a single amount, never a name.
empty_p: Create this year’s campaign: title, dates and goal. It appears on the site when you publish it.
pending_long: {n} amount(s) entered, {a} in all, are waiting for validation: they are not in the public total yet.
public_help: The site only shows the validated total and the validated totals per group.
delete_p: All the amounts entered are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
add_help: One line per amount (for example a Sunday’s total). Never write a donor’s name: the note stays internal, but it does not need one.
entry_added: Amount added: it is waiting for validation.
entries_empty_p: Amounts appear here. The public total only counts the validated ones.
own_entry: You cannot validate an amount you entered yourself: ask someone else.
delete_entry_p: It will no longer count in the total.
goals_help: A goal per group is encouragement (“together”), not a ranking: the site lists them alphabetically, without comparing them.

site.before_p: In {n} day(s), the parish gathers for the Harvest festival.
site.after_t: Thank you: the festival is over
site.after_p: Here is what we gathered together.
site.goal_passed: The goal is passed: thank you!
site.basket: The basket is filling: {p}% of the goal
site.groups_p: Each group has its own goal; this is not a ranking.
site.how_p: The ways to give approved by the parish.
site.program_none: The programme will be published here.
site.none_p: As soon as the campaign is published, you will follow here what we gather together.
